messages:
Maya: Quick async check — Q2 OKR micro-triage. Can each owner post: shipped vs slipped (1 word), one-line blocker, and next step? Top focus: runtime-v3 rollout, autoscale/quota for Dedicated, docs updates, and QA/evals. I'll collate.
Arjun: runtime-v3 rollout: shipped (canary), slipped (wider rollout). Blocker: tail latency regressions on long-seq workloads. Next: correlate logs + approve perf patch from @Liam.
Priya: autoscale & reserved pools: slipped. Blocker: cloud quota bump pending finance approval. Next: got a ticket with billing; pinging Mateo now. ETA depends on approval window.
Liam: perf regressions: investigating — looks like kernel-selection fallback for 4k+ sequences. Repro steps added to the ticket. Plan: small kernel selection fix + add a config guard, aiming for patch by EOD Wed (TS: +48h).
Nora: QA status: smoke harness passed for canary, but golden diffs failing on long-seq evals (test id 4782). Blocker: need Liam's patch to rerun full suite. Next: will re-run nightly job once patch landed and report pass/fail.
Arjun: Also FYI PR #8421 updates quantization flags and default kernels — @Liam can you take a quick review? Diff snippet:
```diff
- use_fast_kernels = false
+ use_fast_kernels = true
```
Priya: Mateo — can you confirm expected timeline for quota bump? If finance needs docs from product, Maya can provide.
Mateo: saw the ping. I can greenlight a temporary quota increase for dedicated pools (48h approval) if you file a short justification (cost delta + owners). Send to finance-requests.
Maya: I'll draft the justification this morning and link it here. Owner matrix: runtime-v3 -> @Arjun, perf patch -> @Liam, autoscale/quota -> @Priya + Mateo, QA/evals -> @Nora, docs -> @Liam (w/ reviewer). Agree? :white_check_mark:
Liam: I can draft the docs note and open a docs PR; @Arjun can add the rollout checklist items.
Arjun: Will add rollout checklist and CR pings. Specific ask: reviewers for PRs 8419/8421/8432 — @Liam, @Priya, @Nora if available.
Nora: I can review 8432 (QA harness changes) tomorrow AM.
deploy-bot: canary rollout started for runtime-v3; rollout_id=rl-202803; current_traffic=10%; target=25% in 4h; status=healthy.
Maya: Timeline/next steps summary I will collate by 10:00am Thu: 1) Liam patch (EOD Wed), 2) Mateo approves quota (48h), 3) PR reviews (Arjun/Liam/Priya/Nora), 4) docs PR and checklist. If any item slips, flag here and I'll escalate to eng-sre. Thanks everyone :rocket:
Arjun: quick blockers list: (a) logs showing increased P95 for 4k seqs, (b) one failing eval case in golden diff. Working both in parallel.
Priya: I filed finance request: FR-5592 (justification attached). Mateo pls confirm once approved and I'll schedule autoscale tests.
Mateo: Approved temporary bump; PR-ops scheduled. Priya, expect update in ~6 hours.
Liam: pushed a draft fix to branch runtime/v3/kernel-select, opened PR 8450. Tagging for review.
Arjun: +1, will review PR 8450 tonight. If it lands, we can bump canary to 25% tomorrow.
Nora: QA rerun queued; will post results here when done. If pass -> signoff for wider rollout.
Maya: thanks all. I'll post the compiled OKR entry and action items after Mateo's confirmation. If you need synchronous call, propose 09:30 Thu. Otherwise keep updates here.
Arjun: cheers. :thumbsup:
Maya: closing the micro-triage thread — will re-open if new blockers surface.
